CUSTOM DESIGN / APPLICATION-SPECIFIC INTEGRATIONMOTOR + CONTROL + SENSING

Designed to fit.
Engineered to work together.

A premium motor starts with the complete system.

We are engineering premium motors and top-of-the-line power electronics around your application. Bring us your available space, load, motion profile, and environment. We work toward an integrated motor assembly with control electronics and feedback matched to the application, reducing the need for separate controller and sensor hardware.

01 / MECHANICAL

Your envelope.

Axial depth, diameter, mounting, load interface, cable routing, and connector placement.

02 / ELECTRICAL

Your operating point.

Winding and KV selection, supply voltage, torque–speed requirements, duty cycle, and thermal path.

03 / CONTROL

Your motion profile.

Application-tuned field-oriented control, torque, speed, and absolute-position modes with CAN FD integration.

04 / ENVIRONMENT

Your qualification plan.

Define temperature, shock, vibration, EMC, material, traceability, and verification requirements for the intended platform.

Start with
the constraints.

Define. Co-design. Prototype. Validate.

We begin with the mechanical envelope, load, operating point, duty cycle, and environment. The design process then brings together the motor, bearing and mounting interfaces, feedback, control electronics, communication, and heat rejection path.

Prototype evaluation will establish performance and integration limits before production requirements and qualification plans are finalized.
